fact: The Early Grade Learning Project piloted a high-frequency survey in which 40 municipal inspectors captured monthly data from a sample of 200 schools on a tablet application (KoboToolbox) for six of nine months in 2020/21 and 2021/22, and developed a strategy for a unique identification code per school; the cleaning, updating and back-up of the EMIS database were taken on by UNESCO under a larger donor-supported programme, and no record per learner or entry by the school is described.
title: Implementation Completion and Results Report on a Grant in the Amount of SDR 27.6 Million (US$40 Million Equivalent) to the Republic of Burundi for Early Grade Learning Project
